notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Auton Soldier, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat each turn.
